title: Preparación E0 de PUB-FB-17_30-47
purpose: Preparar la siguiente publicación programada de Universe Sent Me para una captura E0 válida con tres lecturas controladas dentro de ±600 segundos, sin modificar contenido ni programación.
author: Manus AI (CGO)

selection.selection_basis: Earliest future Facebook publication after the 2026-08-25T19:31:45Z selector checkpoint with explicit Meta_Post_ID, non-cancelled status and explicit experiment mapping.
selection.identity_rule: ID_Pieza remains empty because the Publication Log does not explicitly assign one; asset_ref is preserved as a reference and is not promoted to ID_Pieza.

meta_read_check.interpretation: Meta confirms the scheduled object exists and is not yet published. No E0 was captured during preparation.

e0_control.behavior: Read-only Meta checks; stop at the first response with is_published=true. Capture E0 only if meta_post_id, created_time and all contractual counters are available. If all attempts remain pending, return E0_PENDING without writing a snapshot. If published but outside tolerance, preserve as Late and do not enable E24/E72.
